fusions.name: Falling Stalactite
fusions.desc: Drops a stalactite on the first enemy it meets within 8 tiles. It deals 30 damage, then shatters and hits every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Row of Fangs
fusions.desc: A row of stone tines erupts in a narrow cone 5 tiles ahead. The eruption deals 13 damage to everything in it and stuns each target for 1 second.

fusions.name: Jagged Rampart
fusions.desc: Raises a wall of stone tines 5 tiles long for 6 seconds. Nothing crosses it, and anything that touches it moves 30% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Rock Bottom
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 35%, a shield worth 25% of your maximum health closes over you for 6 seconds. Once every 40 seconds.
